methods: Frozen evidence-only per-case criteria from audit-a-criteria.json, supplemented only by clearly authoritative missing-fact/interview/ready-confirmation/open-draft and changed-outcome constraints in format.md.
All 20 randomized records judged blind to original/revised map, checker feedback, original nonpacket artifacts, and other audit.
Reply and complete supplied drafts judged together. Supplied draft representations treated losslessly; draft prepared claims need no real write.
Actual completed verification claims distinguished from conditional future workflow. No actual mutations, paid CLI calls, or host skill execution inferred.
Ambiguous legitimate workflow mechanics are not marked unsupported solely because absent from user request. Layout/style tracked separately.
limits: Public format.md runtime contract was available to new initial replay drafts, but not supplied verbatim to checker/reviser. This is an asymmetric-input methodological limitation; changed output still judged against the contract.
Full publication-default and station-routing contract not supplied in this judging packet; uncertainty retained rather than adjudicated by invented rules.
Retained cases are purposively enriched; no statistical generalization, native trigger reliability, end-to-end host execution, or matched-compute efficacy claim.
Substantive check-result assertion in X16 unsupported by the judging evidence; this establishes absence of evidentiary support, not proof the source native run never checked anything.
